[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]Design Implementation & Site Planning

The Goring Medical Team are dedicated to our customers. We ensure that we always consider our stakeholders by fully engaging with them. Our services ensure that we provide collaborative value-added solutions that are essential to the design, careful planning, and implementation of your diagnostic medical imaging equipment. We work hard at the design phase to ensure that you are delighted and involved with what will become your working environment. We are very committed to working with you and your team and strive hard to ensure successful planning and installation of your equipment. We aim to deliver your project on time, on budget and to exceed your expectations.

Our services include the following:

  • Project management of new and used equipment
  • Site planning/2D/3D drawings
  • Design and scope building
  • Technical solutions
  • Installation, deinstallation and relocation of all modalities
  • WEE disposal and removing systems at the end of life
  • Rigging and cranes
  • Certified patient data deletion
  • Stakeholder management
  • Turnkey design

Our project management services are controlled by a set of quality focused, PRINCE 2 methodologies, control measures which are implemented through each phase of your project.

Your project will be handled by one of highly trained project managers.  Your PM will be your single point of contact and will be available to support and lead the project from conception to delivery. Your assigned PM will work hard to schedule the design works including room design and layouts, formulation of room data sheets, regulatory compliance, turnkey build works, rigging and installation are performed in a timely manner and on budget. We work in harmony with you and your team to define clear goals, objectives, risk profiling and timelines to optimize your installation process and ensure the best outcome for the project.

Our Project Management Services Include:

  • Provide detailed site surveys
  • New equipment installation
  • Old equipment de-installation
  • Room layout design and comprehensive CAD layouts
  • Perform system audits, system evaluation and inspections
  • Perform Risk Assessments
  • Networking with local authorities
  • Modality specific medical tools and solutions
  • Employ PRINCE 2 Certified and highly qualified Project Managers
  • Tailored project specific solutions to suit local and national regulations
  • Deliver Turnkey design and build solutions
  • Management of JCT contracts
  • Track project costs through software management modules
